description: How fresh is each Distill dataset right now? For every dataset: the as_of and last check its answers carry, the refresh cadence, the next expected update, its current confidence and whether it is late. Read from live answers: each dataset’s probe route answers its example, and the status reports what that answer says. fresh: checked within its cadence; due: within one and a half cadences; stale: later; unavailable: no answer now. Free; also at /status (HTML) and /status.json. Refreshed daily (live freshness: /status). Price: free. Answers in a summary view of about 2,500 tokens; view: "full" for every row. Confidence: The lowest current confidence among the datasets listed (each by its own route’s formula), 0 when one is unavailable. Freshness of the data behind each route; it does not check any single answer.

view.description: summary (the default): the answer a model needs, budgeted; full: every row (a free answer stays capped).
